text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Each dot is an arm's mean score over 31 series (solar, wind, demand, battery, and biofuel) and 53 weekly ECMWF ensemble (ENS) forecast runs, scored from July 2025 to June 2026; average of seeds 0, 1, 2. Each score is a share of the series' own effective capacity. Each line is the 95% interval from resampling whole months. Month-to-month swings are shared by all arms, so overlapping intervals can hide a real gap (see Figure 2). Each dashed vertical line is the score of the named reference: the manual heuristic, climatology (the typical power at that time of day and year), or production as stored. Every arm is an XGBoost model fitted to the same weather data; arms differ only in the changes named in the label. Round 2 labels list the ideas combined: abs. loss is the absolute-error loss, stop is early stopping, lead is the forecast lead-time column, wind is the lean wind-farm columns, pooled is one model per series type with a site identifier, and quantile is training on nine quantile levels with the pinball loss (the quantile arms' CRPS is scored on 51 members x 9 levels samples).'
